statement:
The record marks G-19 “open, cleared for publication,” but it also confirms that the named participants consented to restricted access only, so the consent restriction controls and publication must be withheld.
Publication withheld because the participants consented to restricted access only, despite the conflicting “cleared for publication” label.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the "open, cleared for publication" access level conflicts with restricted-only consent and that "publication must be withheld," identifying the record's access level as the erroneous, impermissible value.
